remarks: Welcome to this beautifully located condo in the heart of downtown Edmonton’s sought-after Rossdale community. Situated just steps from the Legislature Grounds, River Valley trails, and vibrant downtown amenities, this spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit offers the perfect blend of urban convenience and natural beauty. Featuring an open-concept layout, large windows that fill the space with natural light, and a functional kitchen with ample storage, this home is ideal for professionals, students, investors, or anyone looking to enjoy downtown living. The primary suite includes a private ensuite, while the second bedroom offers flexibility for guests, a roommate, or home office. Additional highlights include in-suite laundry, underground parking, and a private balcony to enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Experience walkable living in one of Edmonton’s most desirable river valley communities. (id:67522)
